title: Which Portuguese Sea Words Will You Hear on a Boat in Madeira?
description: Mar, ondulação, baía, fajã, golfinho, lobo-marinho: the Portuguese sea words you will hear on a Madeira boat, what each means here and roughly how to say it.
heroAlt: The bow of a white motor boat lifting over a gentle Atlantic swell off Funchal in the morning

images.prompt: Morning off Funchal, Madeira, about 09:30 in May. Low angle from the middle of the deck of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, looking forward over the empty bow as it lifts gently over a long, smooth Atlantic swell. A coiled white mooring rope and a grey fender lie on the deck in the foreground. Ahead, deep blue water with soft rolling swells, and on the right the green and brown south coast running west towards the faint outline of Cabo Girão. No people, natural light, true colours, realistic photo, no text.
images.alt: The bow of a white motor boat lifting over a gentle Atlantic swell off Funchal in the morning

images.prompt: Realistic photograph from the sea of Ponta do Sol on Madeira's south coast in late morning: the small headland with white houses and the church above a pebble shore of grey stones (calhau), calm blue water in the foreground, steep green slopes behind. No people in close-up, no text.
images.alt: Ponta do Sol headland and its pebble shore seen from the sea
